## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or user capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation, citations, or README updates
- [ ] `perf`: Performance or memory optimization
- [ ] `refactor`: Code cleanup without behavior change
- [ ] `test`: Unit, integration, or parity tests
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, CI, or dependency updates

## Verification & Checklist

- [ ] **Tests pass**: `cargo test --workspace` ran and exited with 0.
- [ ] **UI builds**: `npm run build` in `app/ui` completes without errors or warnings.
- [ ] **Offline privacy**: Confirmed no external telemetry, tracking, or network calls are introduced in core analysis.
- [ ] **Conventional Commits**: Commit messages follow `type(scope): description`.
- [ ] **Scientific honesty**: Any new metrics include exact formulas and benchmark citations.
